messages:
Olivia: Quick idea — before we push the main pricing update, can we run a tiny CTA micro-survey on the pricing page? want to test 'Start free' (freemium-first) vs 'Reserve capacity' (committed-first) and see which yields better qualified leads. keeping it lightweight. :eyes:
Diego: love it. can we also toggle the FAQ snippet copy for commit benefits? short A/B: one focused on pricing predictability, one on discount + SLA.
Maya: for data, prefer conversion funnel + the inbound lead routing tag so Sales can prioritize committed clicks. add param: pricing_variant and lead_tier.
Noah: agree on routing. suggest this as the event payload for GA/Amplitude: `analytics.track('pricing_cta_click', { variant: 'freemium' })` and for committed: `analytics.track('pricing_cta_click', { variant: 'committed', interest: 'dedicated' })`
Sam: can we surface a 1-question microsurvey modal after CTA click if user doesn't convert? something like: "Which best describes your use case? [P0: Proof-of-concept, P1: Launch-scale, P2: Enterprise]" that will help SDRs.
Olivia: good call. keep it optional and single-select. Dylan from sales asked for a scored flag (P1/P2) so we can prioritize.
Diego: mockups: https://rwd.io/internal/pricing-microsurvey — added two variants of the FAQ accordion text and a small inline calculator that estimates monthly tokens/costs for a 50k/200k token workload.
Maya: inline calculator placement question — top of page near tiers or inside each tier card? i'm leaning toward per-tier card so it feels contextual.
Noah: per-tier works but we should also have a global quick calc at top for quick benchmarking. both won't hurt for the test, we'll just instrument clicks separately.
Sam: Routing rules draft: if clicked variant=committed OR microsurvey=P2 => route to sales.high_priority; microsurvey=P1 => sales.medium_priority; freemium clicks => marketing.nurture. Also gzip inbound payloads to keep webhook light.
Olivia: copy changes for FAQ experiment — short bullets, remove heavy legal language. sample: "Dedicated & private options available for regulated workloads — SLA and on-prem packages possible." keeps it simple.
Diego: SEO note — keep H2 with "pricing" and "cost per token" phrasing so search isn't impacted. I'll spin up a headline set tonight.
Maya: timeline? can we QA and deploy GA flags by EOD Wed? small list of deliverables: 1) variants in GTM, 2) microsurvey modal, 3) calculator UI, 4) routing webhook, 5) updated FAQ copy.
Olivia: yes — target Wed EOD for internal rollout. who owns #3 (calculator)? Diego?
Diego: i'll build a lightweight calculator component, will reuse existing cost table. aiming for Monday PR.
Noah: i'll handle routing webhook + SDR flagging. Sam — can you confirm the card copy for Sales playbook?
Sam: will draft playbook bullets and send to Sales for quick sign-off by Tue.
MarketingBot: Reminder: add experiment metadata to Experiment Registry: name=pricing-microcta-2026-03, hypothesis=committed-cta-increases MQL quality by >20%, metrics=click_to_lead, lead_quality_score.
Olivia: nice — added. last question: should we hide calculator behind an accordion on mobile? Diego thoughts?
Diego: on mobile keep a single callout calc with "estimate cost" that expands to full calculator to avoid layout thrash.
Maya: all set from my side. i'll wire GTM events and share a test URL when ready.
Olivia: thanks team — will loop in Sales and Analytics for final signoff. I'll post a standup reminder tomorrow. :rocket:
